{{Quote|These marks are too easy. Not enough credits.|[[Unidentified Balnab bounty hunter/Legends|A bounty hunter]] speaking about several targets, including Toggs|<ref name="Revenge" />}}
'''Omar Toggs''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] criminal who was active during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Revenge" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]] dates the events of "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]" to during the third [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the start of the Clone Wars to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the events of "Revenge" must take place around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Toggs was wanted [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive for 75,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for racketeering and extortion. Together with others, their [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was listed in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] discussed their next target. However, they deemed Toggs as uninteresting because their bounty was too low. Toggs had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Behind the scenes==
An image of Toggs first appeared in "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]],"<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> the twentieth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 2]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: Bounty">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep420|text="Bounty" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
